title: kate-ui: list the visible tree rows
summary: visible_rows flattens a TreeNode into the rows the pane paints: the root's children at depth 0 and the children of each expanded directory one level deeper. A collapsed directory shows one row. The expanded set holds directory paths.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. The file has no GPUI import, but kate-ui tests run in the rust (macos-15) job and the Mac lane owns crates/kate-ui.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Walk the root's children in order. Push a row for each child; when the child is a directory in expanded, recurse with depth + 1. The test visible_rows_follow_the_expanded_set builds the tree from [src/main.rs, README.md] and asserts an empty set gives rows src and README.md with expanded false, and a set with src gives src, main.rs at depth 1, and README.md. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: tree::tests::visible_rows_follow_the_expanded_set
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because visible_rows does not exist. After the change a collapsed directory is one row and an expanded one shows its children one level deeper.
